observed: The admitted 0.2.96 gallery run reached initial_owned_empty_ui after one exact owned-page GET returned HTTP 200 and zero rows. The gallery was active, selected and linked, with Refresh and empty state visible; only its canonical marker assertion was false. Failure injection and recovery were not reached.
root_cause: ScreenshotsView displays canonicalUrl as the header span text while setting the same span's title to the raw tab.url. The gallery-failure and admin-readonly runners compared span.title to an expected canonical URL. The owned localhost URL has a scheme, so that comparison rejects the correct marker.

sibling_census.already_correct: tests/browser/screenshot-capture-acceptance.mjs compares the displayed span text to the expected canonical value.
sibling_census.no_marker_assertion: tests/browser/screenshot-full-page-acceptance.mjs verifies page identity and matching network rows without this DOM marker query.

repair: Both affected runners now require exactly one span with the exact displayed canonical URL, scoped to the Screenshots tab's linked panel. Their other tab, network, and gallery assertions remain intact.

verification.focused_dom_replay: Using the actual gallery evaluator functions from HEAD and the changed working files against a DOM matching ScreenshotsView's raw-URL tooltip and canonical visible text: old evaluators returned false for the owned page; changed evaluators returned true for the owned page and false for a different canonical page in both runners.

open: The gallery failure injection and Refresh recovery still require a fresh native acceptance run against these runner changes.
The historical organization-selection pointer failure remains unexplained; this repair addresses only the independently proven canonical marker mismatch.
